properties.content: Question: covid nasal swab test Answer: A COVID-19 nasal swab test involves taking a sample from the nasal cavity to detect the presence of the SARS-CoV-2 virus, which causes COVID-19. Specifically, a nasopharyngeal swab is inserted into the nostril and advanced far back into the nasal cavity to collect the sample. This test is accurate when performed by a trained professional, according to the Cleveland Clinic. The test can be used to diagnose other respiratory infections as well, such as the flu and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV).
